The Nudists

By: Jo Munnik | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
We visit South Africa's first official nudist beach.

Summary:
On 28 October 2014, Mpenjati beach in KZN was declared SA's first naturist / nudist beach. This is SA's first official naturist beach. Despite opposition from many locals, SANNA (the SA naturist nudist association) were successful in their application to the Hisbiscus municipality and believe it is a great way to boost the SA tourist industry by having SA officially declared a naturist destination. They also believe it is the fist step in protecting and promoting the rights of naturists in SA.
We talk to the nudist association about the philosophy of nudism / naturism and find out where locals and tourists who have an affinity for nudity can safely beach this December. We also look at how this big step for nudity has now set a precedent to have other unofficial destinations (such as the very popular Sandy Bay) legalised as official nudist beaches.

Further information:
We look at the philosophy of nudism / naturism and the growing movement in SA. SANNA was established in 2010.
There is a nude bike ride every March in CPT to promote nudism - footage is available.
We look at official nudist destinations around the world. and what it means for SA tourism.
Want to beach in the nude this December - where to go. Nude beaches you may not have known are not actually official.
Speak to the locals in Trafalgar who both promoted and opposed the legalising of the nudist beach. This includes tribal leaders who were opposed.

NB- the SA nudist association is meeting this weekend in PTA. With their spokesperson Serge. Who is actually based in CPT. Might be nice to do an interview with them there.. They will all be in the nude. Obviously we will cover them up!

Script:


VO
HAVE YOU EVER HAD THE URGE TO TAKE OFF YOUR CLOTHES AND BARE IT ALL IN PUBLIC? WELL DON’T WORRY, YOU ARE NOT ALONE.

AIMEE HOPPE
I FIND CLOTHES VERY RESTRICTING. SO I CAN FEEL THE AIR BLOWING AGAINST MY SKIN, THE SUN AGAINST MY SKIN. THERE IS NO BARRIER BETWEEN ME AND THE OUTSIDE ELEMENTS. IT JUST FEELS NATURAL.
JOHN – THERE’S NOTHING BETTER THAN BEARING IT ALL.

JOHN SKENE
THERE IS NOTHING LIKE FEELNG THE WIND IN YOUR HAIR AND ON YOUR BODY.

DEVI LINK:
NATURISM OR NUDISM IS A LOT MORE COMMON THAN YOU MAY THINK AND IS A GROWING LIFESTYLE CHOICE HERE IN SA.

SERGE
NATURISM IS TO ME ONE OF THE MOST BEAUTIFUL LIFESTYLES YOU CAN HAVE ON THIS EARTH.

VO
WE WENT ON A MISSION TO DISCOVER MORE ABOUT THE LOCAL NATURIST MOVEMENT. IT WAS AN EDUCATION - AND NOT JUST IN KEEPING FIRM EYE CONTACT. WE MET UP WITH SERGE PAVLOVIC WHO IS THE SPOKESPERSON FOR THE SA NATIONAL NATURIST ASSOCIATION. HE HAS BEEN PRACTICING NATURISM SINCE THE AGE OF TEN.

DEVI:
HOW BIG A FOLLOWING IS THERE IN SOUTH AFRICA?

SERGE:
COUPLE OF THOUSAND PEOPLE, MAYBE EVEN TEN THOUSAND PEOPLE. .. LARGE PORTION LIKE TO WALK AROUND NUDE.


DEVI:
WHERE CAN NATURISTS GO TO HANG OUT IN SA?

SERGE:
THERE IS … . AND MPENJATI BEACH IN KZN, WHICH IS THE ONLY OFFICIAL BEACH.


DEVI LINK
IN OCTOBER MPENJATI WAS DECLARED AS SA’S FIRST OFFICIAL NUDIST BEACH.


DEVI: WHAT DOES IT FEEL LIKE TO BE THE FIRST IN SOUTH AFRICA?

SIMON: WE ARE PROUD THAT WE TOOK A BOLD STANCE AND AN INFORMED ONE.

VO
MPENJATI BEACH HAS BEEN AN UNOFFICIAL NATURIST BEACH FOR ALMOST TWENTY YEARS. IT IS LOCATED IN TRAFALGAR ON THE HIBISCUS COAST NEARBY PORT EDWARD ON A SECLUDED STRETCH OF BEACH WHICH IS AT THE MOMENT RELATIVELY DIFFICULT TO ACCESS. BUT NOT FOR LONG.

SIMON: WE HAVE TO CONSTRUCT ACCESS AND BUILD ABLUTIONS.

DEVI: HOW MUCH LONGER DO YOU THINK?

SIMON: LESS THAN A YEAR.

DAVE WATSON: HAVING MADE IT OFFICIAL IT’S SUCH A PROFOUND PRECEDENT FOR OUR MUNICIPALITY. PUBLIC NUDITY IS ILLEGAL AND THE BEACH IS VERY MUCH A PUBLIC FACILITY.

VOICE OVER: DAVE WATSON IS A DA COUNCILLOR WHO REPRESENTED THE OPPOSITION FROM THE LOCAL COMMUNITY.

DAVE: WE USED TO HAVE A LOVELY SLOGAN DOWN HERE, WE USED TO SAY COME DOWN TO THE SOUTH COAST AND IT’S UNFORTUNATELY RUINED OUR SLOGAN.

VOICE OVER:
JOHN SKENE IS VERY COMFORTABLE WITH LETTING IT ALL HANG OUT.
HE IS A NUDIST WHOSE BEEN RUNNING A NATURIST FRIENDLY GUEST HOUSE IN KZN FOR THE PAST 10 YEARS. JOHN KINDLY DRESSED UP FOR THE INTERVIEW.

JOHN: KZN HAS 585 KM OF BEACH. WE HAVE ONLY ASKED FOR 500 METRES.

DEVI: HOW BIG IS THE NATURIST FOLLOWING HERE, ON THE SOUTH COAST?

JOHN: THIS AREA IS VERY AREA POPULAR WITH EUROPEAN TOURISTS … THEYY LOVE THIS AREA. A NATURIST BEACH WOULD BE A FEATHER IN OUR CAP ..

JOHN: IT IS GOING TO BE USED FOR LOCALS TOO.

DEVI LINK:
WHILE NUDISTS SAY THERE ARE MANY PERKS, NOT EVERYONE IS OPEN TO THE IDEA.


SIMON: THERE IS A LOT OF OPPOSITION TO US APPROVING THIS APPLICATION. ESPECIALLY FROM THE RURAL COMMUNITY AND RELIGIOUS SECTOR.


REVEREND:
THE CHRISTIAN FRATERNITY DOES NOT ACCEPT IT. AND EVEN THE TRADITIONS AND CULTURES ARE NOT ACCEPTING IT. MY CONGREGATION IS ANGRY.

VOICE OVER:
MANY PEOPLE BELIEVES THAT NUDITY OR NATURISM IS IMMORAL AND THAT IT PROMOTES SEX, ORGIES AND EVEN SWINGING.

ROD WATERMEYER
PEOPLE THINK THAT NATURISTS ARE A BUNCH OF PERVERTS AND KOOKS. IN ACTUAL FACT THEY ARE NOT. NATURIST ARE PEOPLE THAT LIKE TO LIVE AT ONE WITH NATURE WHO HAVEN’T GOT ANY PRE CONCEIVED IDEAS ABOUT WEALTH AND MATERIAL THINGS.

DEVI: DO YOU THINK MUNICIPALITY IS WRONG? HAVE THEY MADE THE WRONG DECISION?

REVEREND NCANE: YES.

DEVI LINK:
THE HIBISCUS MUNICIPALITY IS POSITIVE THAT THIS BEACH IS GOING TO DRAW A GLOBAL AUDIENCE.

SIMON: IN TERMS OF OUR RESEARCH, NATURISTS ARE LIVING FROM MIDDLE CLASS UPWARDS. THEY ARE GOOD SPENDERS.

DEVI: ARE OTHER MUNICIPALITIES CALLING YOU UP AND SAYING HEY TELL US ABOUT THIS.

SIMON: YES, INTERESTINGLY WHEN PEOPLE HEAR YOU ARE COMING FROM HIBISCUS COAST THEY SAY – OH..

DEVI: YOU’RE THE NAKED GUYS!

SIMON: JA, LAUGHING, AND THEY ASK QUESTIONS.

JOHN: NOW THAT WE HAVE A NATURIST FRIENDLY BEACH, WE CAN MARKET SOUTH AFRICA AS A TOURIST DESTINATION. I AM SURE OTHER BEACHES WILL ALSO PUT THROUGH APPLICATIONS.

DAVE ANDREWS: THE PRECEDENT HAS BEEN SET. THE LINE HAS BEEN CROSSED AND I AM NOT SURE IF WE ARE READY FOR THAT.

DEVI: DO YOU THINK OTHER BEACHES IN SOUTH AFRICA ARE GOING TO FOLLOW?

SIMON: WE HOPE THAT THEY WILL FOLLOW. IT IS NOT JUST ABOUT US BENEFITING, IT IS ABOUT THE WHOLE OF SOUTH AFRICA BENEFITING.

VOICE OVER:
MPENJATI BEACH IS A FIRST IN SA, BUT THE NATURIST COMMUNITY HOPE IT WON’T BE THE LAST.

ROD
SANDY BAY IN ACTUAL FACT IS WORLD FAMOUS. A LOT OF PEOPLE DON’T KNOW THIS, BUT IF YOU SPEAK TO NATURISTS AROUND THE WORLD THEY KNOW ABOUT SANDY BAY. WE’VE GOT PEOPLE FROM ALL OVER THE WORLD COMING HERE, ESPECIALLY EUROPEANS. THESE PEOPLE BRING MONEY. THE POWERS THAT BE DON’T SEEM TO REALISE THAT THERE IS A NATURIST DOLLAR. I WOULD REALLY LIKE TO SEE THIS BEACH OFFICIALLY BE MADE A NATURIST BEACH.

VO:
PEOPLE HAVE BEEN STRIPPING DOWN AT SANDY BAY SINCE THE 1980’S AND THE INTERNET IS AWASH WITH IMAGES OF SANDY BAY BEACH BUMS. JOHN WEBB WENT TO SEE WHAT THE FUSS IS ABOUT.

JOHN AMY HOW LONG HAVE YOU BEEN A NATURIST FOR?

AIMEE SINCE 2006. WE TOOK A VISIT TO SANDY BAY AND SINCE THEN I’VE BEEN HOOKED.

JOHN : DO YOU REMEMBER THE FIRST TIME, WHAT WAS THAT LIKE?

AIMEE: IT WAS VERY LIBERATING. TO FEEL THE WIND ON YOUR SKIN AND TO TAN WITHOUT TAN LINES. AND TO NOT FEEL CONSCIOUS ABOUT YOURSELF, IT WAS LOVELY.

VOICE OVER
NATURISTS NEVER FORGET THEIR FIRST TIME. BUT FOR SOME IT IS A LITTLE MORE DAUNTING THAN FOR OTHERS LIKE FOR PRETORIA BASED COUPLE HUGH AND ANGIE.


DEVI: HOW DID YOU GET INTO NATURISM?

HUGH: ANGIE HEARD ABOUT IT AND FOR ABOUT THREE OR FOUR MONTHS NAGGED ME TO COME HER. BUT I WAS PETRIFIED. EVENTUALLY WE CAME THROUGH, TOOK OUR CLOTHES OFF AND I SAT UNDER THAT BAR AND WOULD NOT MOVE. I SAT THERE FOR 2 HOURS. IT TOOK ME A GOOD FEW HOURS BECAUSE ONE ISN’T USED TO WALKING AROUND WITHOUT YOUR CLOTHES ON, IT’S JUST NOT THE WAY YOU ARE BROUGHT UP. A COUPLE OF HOURS LATER YOU REALISE YOU ARE NOT EVEN NAKED ANYMORE.

VOICE OVER:
NATURISM IS PRACTISED ALL OVER SA. WE CHECKED OUT WHAT THE SCENE IN GAUTENG HAD TO OFFER.

DEVI LINK:
SUN EDEN IS ONE OF MANY FAMILY ORIENTATED NATURIST RESORTS IN SOUTH AFRICA. HERE PEOPLE ARE FREE TO HANG OUT JUST AS THEY ARE.

DEVI: NOW YOU HAVE KIDS. WITH KIDS, HOW DOES IT WORK?


HUGH & ANGIE: THEY ARE MORE COMFORTABLE WITH NUDITY THAN WE ARE. THEY ARE USED TO IT. IT’S NOT A SEXUAL THING FOR THEM, IT IS NATURAL.


DEVI: WHAT ARE SOME OF THE PRE CONCEPTIONS PEOPLE HAVE ABOUT NATURISTS. WHAT DO THEY THINK YOU GUYS DO HERE?

SERGE: I WILL TELL YOU ABOUT MY OWN EXPERIENCE, WHEN I TELL THEM I AM A NATURIST THEY THINK I AM A SWINGER. WHICH IS SO FAR AWAY FROM TRUTH THAT IT’S NOT EVEN FUNNY.


JOHN
PEOPLE WHO AREN’T FAMILIAR WITH NATURISM AIMEE OFTEN ASSOCIATE IT WITH SOME KIND OF OVERT SEXUALITY. IS THAT TRUE?

AIMEE
YES IT IS TRUE. AND A LOT OF THE TIME IT COMES FROM RELIGION OR THE WAY THEY WERE BROUGHT UP. THEY ARE TAUGHT TO BE ASHAMED OF THEIR BODIES. THAT NUDITY IS UGLY AND IT IS ACTUALLY NOT – IT IS QUITE NATURAL.


SERGE: SWINGING AND NATURISM HAVE NOTHING TO DO WITH EACH OTHER. NATURISM HAS GOT NOTHING TO DO WITH SEX.


DEVI: IS THERE A CODE OF CONDUCT WHEN NATURISTS GET TOGETHER?

HUGH
THERE IS NO SEXUAL ACTIVITY IN PUBLIC WHATSOEVER.

DEVI: YOU’VE GOT TO BE VERY COMFORTABLE IN YOUR OWN BODY. ARE YOU TWO TELLING ME YOU’VE GOT NO HANG UPS?


HUGH:
WE FEEL MORE COMFORTABLE WITH OUR BODIES. I WAS VERY SHY BEFORE I CAME HERE AND I’VE BECOME USED TO MY BODY. WHAT YOU SEE, COMING TO A PLACE LIKE THIS, IS EVERYBODY HAS IMPERFECTIONS. NOBODY IS PERFECT AND IN FACT IT TEACHES YOU TO LOVE YOURSELF MORE. RESPECT YOUR OWN BODY MORE. INSTEAD OF BEING ASHAMED OF IT.

VOICE OVER
WHILE NATURISM IS SAID TO BE FOR ANYONE AND EVERYONE WE FOUND THAT THE LOCAL POOL IS MADE UP MOSTLY OF MIDDLE CLASS, MIDDLE AGED, WHITE PEOPLE.

SERGE:
THE MOST SURPRISING THING IS THAT IT IS AN AFRIKANER WHITE THING. THE MAJORITY OF NATURISTS IN THIS COUNTRY THEY ARE WHITE AFRIKANERS. WHY? I DON’T KNOW.
THE INTEREST IS GROWING FROM THE OTHER CULTURES AND RACIAL GROUPS.


DEVI: DO YOUR EMPLOYEES KNOW THAT YOU ARE A NATURIST?

SERGE: YES. EVERYBODY.

VOICE OVER
BUT NOT ALL NATURISTS ARE AS OPEN AS SERGE ABOUT THEIR STATUS.

JOHN:
A LOT OF PEOPLE ARE WHAT WE CALL CLOSET NATURISTS – THEY DO IT IN THEIR OWN HOME, THEY DO IT IN THEIR OWN YARD BUT THEY DON’T DO IT IN PUBLIC. BUT I WOULD SAY THERE ARE THOUSANDS OF NATURISTS IN KZN AND WE HAVE TO TAP INTO THAT MARKET.

SERGE
BUT WHEN IT COMES TO SOCIAL NUDISM, NATURISM THAT IS WHEN WE REALLY START HAVING THE BARRIERS. PEOPLE START THINKING ABOUT WHAT ARE ARE MY COLLEAGUES GOING TO SAY AND MY FAMILY GOING TO SAY..

DEVI: WOULD YOU ENCOURAGE PEOPLE TO GIVE THIS A GO?

ANGIE & HUGH: DEFINITELY.


SERGE: I DO ENCOURAGE NATURISTS AROUND THE COUNTRY TO GET OUT OF THE CLOSET. BECAUSE I DO BELIEVE WE NEED TO DO THAT TO PROMOTE NATURISM TO THE PUBLIC AT LARGE.



PROMOS

1.
MANY SOUTH AFRICANS ARE STRIPPING DOWN TO BARE IT ALL.
SOUND UP
WE FOUND OUT WHAT THE APPEAL IS OF NATURISM.

2.
SOUTH AFRICA HAS JUST HAD ITS FIRST OFFICIAL NATURIST BEACH DECLARED. BUT BEACH BUMS IS NOT EVERYONE’S CUP OF TEA.

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): We visit South Africa's first official nudist beach.
metadata.Summary: On 28 October 2014, Mpenjati beach in KZN was declared SA's first naturist / nudist beach. This is SA's first official naturist beach. Despite opposition from many locals, SANNA (the SA naturist nudist association) were successful in their application to the Hisbiscus municipality and believe it is a great way to boost the SA tourist industry by having SA officially declared a naturist destination. They also believe it is the fist step in protecting and promoting the rights of naturists in SA. We talk to the nudist association about the philosophy of nudism / naturism and find out where locals and tourists who have an affinity for nudity can safely beach this December. We also look at how this big step for nudity has now set a precedent to have other unofficial destinations (such as the very popular Sandy Bay) legalised as official nudist beaches.
metadata.Further information: We look at the philosophy of nudism / naturism and the growing movement in SA. SANNA was established in 2010. There is a nude bike ride every March in CPT to promote nudism - footage is available. We look at official nudist destinations around the world. and what it means for SA tourism. Want to beach in the nude this December - where to go. Nude beaches you may not have known are not actually official. Speak to the locals in Trafalgar who both promoted and opposed the legalising of the nudist beach. This includes tribal leaders who were opposed. NB- the SA nudist association is meeting this weekend in PTA. With their spokesperson Serge. Who is actually based in CPT. Might be nice to do an interview with them there.. They will all be in the nude. Obviously we will cover them up!
